comment: Curated snapshot. Market data from CoinGecko, fees/revenue from DefiLlama (30d run-rates annualized — honest current baseline, not trailing-12m peaks), unlock schedules from official docs/tokenomist/cryptorank, cross-checked. Sources and full research notes in data/research/.

tokens.name: Solana
tokens.revenueNote: Network fees ~$166M annualized (30d run-rate); ~50% of base fees are burned, priority fees and MEV tips flow to stakers. SOL is valued as the monetary asset of the network, not on protocol revenue.
tokens.unlockNote: No investor cliffs remain. Supply grows ~4%/yr from staking inflation (disinflating toward 1.5%), partly offset by fee burn.
tokens.valueCapture: Staking rewards + MEV tips to stakers; 50% base-fee burn; gas and collateral asset of the ecosystem.
tokens.marketShareNote: ~1.9% of total crypto market cap today; peaked at ~3.8% in Jan 2025, bottomed near 0.4% in the 2022 trough.

comparables.name: SOL's Jan 2025 all-time-high market cap
SOL's Nov 2021 cycle-peak market cap

tokens.cycleBetaNote: Modeled on total-market share, not the app-token class — its size discipline comes from the share bands (0.4% trough, 1.9% today, ~3.8% peak).
tokens.caveats: ATH market cap estimates range $135–143B depending on the supply snapshot used.

monetary.note: SOL is ~1.9% of total crypto today; peaked at ~3.8% in Jan 2025, bottomed near 0.4% in the 2022 trough — its share has risen every cycle.

tokens.name: Seeker (Solana Mobile)
tokens.revenueNote: No token-captured revenue yet: Seeker hardware sales accrue to Solana Mobile the company, and dApp-store fee capture for SKR is not live. SKR is priced on ecosystem adoption, not cash flow — the plausibility layer is n/a until capture exists.
tokens.unlockNote: TGE Jan 21, 2026 with ~4.5-4.9B unlocked (30% airdrop + liquidity + treasury + 10% of growth). Growth & Partnerships (2.25B remaining) vests linearly to ~mid-2027; Solana Mobile (15%) + Solana Labs (10%) sit behind a 12-month cliff (Jan 2027) then 36-month linear vest to 2030 — supply roughly doubles by end-2029. A 10%-decaying reward-inflation schedule adds emissions on top.
tokens.valueCapture: Weak today: ecosystem rewards, payments and staking within the Seeker ecosystem; no fee share or buyback. Value capture is a bet on future dApp-store economics.
tokens.marketShareNote: The only meaningful token of the Solana mobile/consumer-hardware vertical (Seeker phone, ~150k+ units preordered, dApp store). Effectively ~100% of a very small pool today (~0.002% of total crypto).

comparables.name: Helium (HNT) 2021 DePIN peak market cap
Helium (HNT) 2024-25 cycle peak market cap
SKR's own TGE-day peak market cap

v2.shareNote: SKR effectively IS the Solana mobile pool (~100% today); the range below 100% leaves room for future entrants and non-token value leakage to Solana Mobile equity.
v2.captureNote: No fee share or buyback today — heavy discount in cold regimes; hot regimes price dApp-store economics switching on ahead of execution.

cycleAnchor.note: No cycle history (Jan 2026 TGE). The $0.0569 price ATH (Jan 22, 2026) was a TGE-day pop worth ~$267M on ~4.7B circulating — matching that same valuation at 2029's ~8.8B supply prices only ~$0.030, which is why price-ATH comparisons mislead here. Anchor referenced to Helium's realized DePIN peaks ($5.2B in 2021, ~$1.5B in the 2024-25 cycle), scaled down for the smaller proven mobile vertical. Approximate by construction.

tokens.caveats: Young token (Jan 2026 TGE) — figures as of 2026-07-17. Trackers disagree on circulating supply (CoinGecko ~4.94B vs CMC ~6.6B; mcap $45-61M) — CoinGecko used; re-verify at next refresh. Supply roughly doubles by end-2029, so every scenario PRICE lags its market-cap multiple — the honest cost of unlocks.

tokens.name: Jupiter
tokens.revenueNote: Protocol revenue ~$59M annualized (30d run-rate; trailing 12m was $118M). Total platform fees ~$192M annualized across aggregator, perps, lend and launchpad.
tokens.unlockNote: 3B JUP burned in 2025 (max supply cut to ~6.87B). The 2026 'Going Green' vote ended team vesting and cancelled remaining Jupuary emissions — net new supply through 2027 is roughly zero.
tokens.valueCapture: 50% of protocol revenue buys back JUP into the Litterbox Trust (3-year lock, partly burned); Active Staking Rewards for voters.
tokens.marketShareNote: ~60%+ of aggregated Solana DEX flow; leading on-Solana perps venue; expanding into lending, mobile and launchpad.

comparables.name: Uniswap's all-time-peak market cap
JUP's own all-time-high market cap

v2.shareNote: Ecosystem financial super-app: ~25% of the Solana DeFi app-token pool at the 2025 peak ($2.7B of ~$10.8B); the range prices consolidation toward 28% in hot regimes (aggregator + perps + lend + mobile + launchpad).
v2.captureNote: Strongest value capture in the set: 50%-of-revenue buyback (Litterbox), near-zero net emissions — small discount even in cold regimes.

cycleAnchor.note: VERIFIED max realized mcap: $2.65-2.71B on Feb 1, 2025 ($0.93 × 2.92B circulating, right after the Jupuary unlock; CMC full daily history + archived pages). The $2.04 price ATH (TGE, Jan 2024) was a first-hours print on 1.35B float; Jan 2025's price high was $1.26 (~$2.13B intraday). Price history misleads here — mcap doesn't.

tokens.caveats: ~3.5B non-circulating JUP has no scheduled unlock, but governance could reactivate emissions.

tokens.name: Raydium
tokens.revenueNote: Protocol revenue ~$7.7M annualized (30d run-rate — down hard from the 2025 memecoin boom; trailing 12m was $36M). Total trading fees ~$50M annualized, most of which goes to LPs.
tokens.unlockNote: No cliffs — vesting completed years ago. Slow ecosystem-reserve emissions are largely offset by the protocol's continuous buybacks.
tokens.valueCapture: 12% of all trading fees market-buy RAY (held by the protocol); 4% to treasury; staking and governance.
tokens.marketShareNote: Long-time #1–2 Solana AMM; realistic steady-state share ~15–30% of Solana spot DEX volume, volatile vs Orca, PumpSwap and Meteora.

comparables.name: RAY's own Jan 2025 peak market cap
RAY's 2021 cycle-peak market cap

v2.shareNote: Mature DEX with a real share loss: ~22% of the pool at the 2025 peak, ~7% today (PumpSwap/Meteora/Orca took volume). The range prices partial recovery toward 15% in hot regimes, not a full return to 22%.
v2.captureNote: Continuous 12%-of-fees buyback since 2021 — solid capture, small discount.

cycleAnchor.note: VERIFIED max realized mcap: $2.369B EOD on Jan 23, 2025 (close $8.15, 290.9M circulating; intraday cycle-high $8.65 ≈ $2.52B) during the TRUMP-launch frenzy. The $16.83 price ATH (Sep 2021) is NOT the mcap max — float was only ~70M then (verified snapshot: $1.01B). Previous-cycle peak: ~$1.01B.

tokens.caveats: Price ATH ($16.83) dates to Sep 2021 on a much smaller float; the Jan 2025 market-cap peak (~$2.4B) is the higher watermark.

tokens.name: Meteora
tokens.revenueNote: Protocol revenue ~$24M annualized (30d run-rate). Total fees ~$180M annualized — among the highest on Solana, comparable to or above Raydium's.
tokens.unlockNote: Team (18%) and reserve (34%) vest linearly at ~7.2M MET/month until Oct 2031 — steady, predictable dilution of ~16% over the next 12 months.
tokens.valueCapture: Governance only — no fee share, buyback or staking yield today. Protocol revenue accrues to the treasury and LPs.
tokens.marketShareNote: #2–3 Solana AMM by volume (~14% of Solana DEX volume in Q1 2026, rising); the top venue for launchpad and DBC token liquidity.

comparables.name: Raydium's Jan 2025 peak market cap (the closest comparable AMM)
Raydium's 2021 cycle-peak market cap

v2.shareNote: Newer liquidity infrastructure, ~3% of the pool today with ~14% of Solana DEX volume — usage outruns valuation. Hot regimes price share toward 9% (RAY-class), with execution uncertainty keeping it below the mature comps.
v2.captureNote: Governance-only today (no fee share, no buyback) — heavy discount in cold regimes; hot regimes price capture switching on ahead of any DAO vote.

cycleAnchor.note: MET has no full-cycle history (Oct 2025 TGE; its verified own max is just $265M, listing day — not a cycle peak). Anchor set between Raydium's verified realized cycle peaks ($1.01B in 2021, $2.37B in 2025) — the closest mature Solana-AMM comparable — reflecting MET's #2-3 AMM position. Approximate by construction.

tokens.caveats: Young token (Oct 2025 TGE). Trailing fee data is inflated by the late-2025 launchpad frenzy; run-rates used instead.

tokens.name: Pump.fun
tokens.revenueNote: Protocol revenue ~$228M annualized (30d run-rate; 2025 full year was ~$971M — revenue is decaying as memecoin activity cools). The largest revenue generator among Solana app tokens.
tokens.unlockNote: Team + investor tokens (33% of supply) vest through mid-2029 at ~6.9B/month after the July 2026 cliff. Buyback-and-burn has already retired ~145B tokens (~15% of max supply), partly offsetting unlocks.
tokens.valueCapture: 50% of net revenue is contract-locked into programmatic buyback-and-burn (since Apr 2026). No governance rights, no contractual claim on revenue.
tokens.marketShareNote: #1 Solana memecoin launchpad (~50–75% of launchpad activity); Q1 2026 revenue was ~36% of ALL Solana app revenue.

comparables.name: PUMP's own all-time-high market cap
Hyperliquid (HYPE) — the benchmark buyback token — market cap

v2.shareNote: Dominant consumer/speculative issuance platform: ~50-75% of Solana launchpad activity; the sector itself is the most cycle-elastic pool in the model (PUMP alone was ~0.08% of ALL crypto at its Sep 2025 peak).
v2.captureNote: 50% of net revenue contract-locked into buyback-and-burn — mechanically strong capture.

cycleAnchor.note: VERIFIED max realized mcap: $3.05B EOD on Sep 15, 2025 (~$0.0086 × ~354B circulating; two aggregators agree within 0.5%). Set during the 100%-revenue-buyback era, weeks before the market top.

tokens.caveats: Revenue depends entirely on memecoin activity — the most cyclical business model in the set. Trades at ~3× revenue vs Hyperliquid's ~39× — the market prices the decay.

tokens.name: Jito
tokens.revenueNote: DAO-captured revenue ~$4.4M annualized (30d run-rate) from MEV tip fees. Total MEV tips ~$80M annualized (down from the 2025 peak — the widely-quoted '$300M' is stale). Upside: BAM fees and the new JTX buyback (JIP-38, Jul 2026) are just switching on.
tokens.unlockNote: Insider vesting (investors 16%, contributors 24.5%) runs linearly through Dec 2027 — roughly 13–19M JTO unlocking per month, ~31% supply growth over the next 12 months.
tokens.valueCapture: DAO fee accrual (6% block-engine fee, TipRouter fees, priority-fee share) + new JTO buyback-and-burn funded by JTX platform revenue (JIP-38).
tokens.marketShareNote: Jito client runs on >90% of Solana validators; JitoSOL (~$760M TVL) is tied for the largest single Solana LST.

comparables.name: Lido (LDO) — the LST sector leader — peak market cap
JTO's own all-time-high market cap

v2.shareNote: Staking/MEV infrastructure: ~9% of the pool at the 2025 peak, ~11% today. Ubiquitous (>90% of validators) but its sector share has a natural ceiling — infrastructure rarely outgrows the apps built on it.
v2.captureNote: DAO fee accrual is young (JIP-24 2025, JIP-38 buyback Jul 2026) — meaningful discount in cold regimes, compressing as the mechanisms mature.

cycleAnchor.note: VERIFIED max realized mcap: $979M EOD on Jan 31, 2025 (close $3.39 × 289M circulating; intraday ≈ $1.02-1.04B; CMC full history + archived pages). The Dec 2023 / Apr 2024 price-ATH era had only a ~115M float (mcap $405-473M) — price history misleads.

tokens.caveats: DAO revenue capture is young and growing (JIP-24/JIP-38 both 2025–26); the $4.4M base may understate a recovery scenario.

tokens.name: Pyth Network
tokens.revenueNote: Revenue ~$3M ARR from Pyth Pro institutional subscriptions (launched Sep 2025; management targets $10M by end-2026). On-chain oracle fees are negligible. This is a bet on the institutional market-data business, not current cash flow.
tokens.unlockNote: The textbook low-float/high-FDV token: the final 21% cliff (~2.1B PYTH) hits May 2027, taking supply to fully diluted. Every previous cliff preceded a lower price regime ($0.58 → $0.135 → $0.0295).
tokens.valueCapture: Governance + Oracle Integrity Staking (rewards currently paused); 33% of protocol revenue funds a buyback — so far ~$0.6M repurchased vs ~2.1B tokens/yr unlocking.
tokens.marketShareNote: #2 DeFi oracle (~$3.1B secured vs Chainlink's $33B); dominant on Solana; US Dept of Commerce data deal (Sep 2025).

comparables.name: Chainlink's 2021 peak market cap
Chainlink's current market cap

v2.shareNote: Cross-chain oracle: #2 by usage (~$3.1B secured vs Chainlink's $33B; ~8% of oracle-sector mcap today). Hot regimes price share gains toward 14% on the institutional market-data story (Pyth Pro, US Dept of Commerce deal).
v2.captureNote: Weak capture: OIS rewards paused, buyback negligible vs unlocks — heavy discount in cold regimes; the $10M-ARR institutional trajectory compresses it in hot ones.

cycleAnchor.note: VERIFIED max realized mcap: $1.914B EOD on Dec 3, 2024 (close $0.528 × 3.625B circulating, post May-2024 unlock; intraday ≈ $2.0B). The $1.15-1.20 price ATH (Mar 2024) was a low-float print worth only ~$1.64-1.73B — the real peak came later at a lower price on more supply.

tokens.caveats: Buyback exists but is negligible against unlock flow. The May 2027 final cliff (~27% of current circulating) is the key supply event.

tokens.name: Kamino Finance
tokens.revenueNote: Protocol revenue ~$8M annualized (30d run-rate); total fees ~$55M annualized, most paid to lenders. TVL ~$1.1B, down from ~$3.4B in Oct 2025.
tokens.unlockNote: Insider tranches (~55% of supply) vest at ~229M KMNO/month until Apr 2027 — ~46% supply growth over the next 12 months, the heaviest dilution in this set.
tokens.valueCapture: Governance and staking boosts only — no fee share and no standing buyback (fees accrue to the DAO treasury; buybacks at DAO discretion).
tokens.marketShareNote: ~49% of major Solana lending TVL, but Jupiter Lend reached near-parity within a year of launching — the existential competitive threat.

comparables.name: Aave's 2021 peak market cap (lending sector ceiling)
Compound's 2021 peak market cap

v2.shareNote: Lending/capital-efficiency: ~3% of the pool at the 2025 peak and today. Still ~49% of Solana lending TVL but Jupiter Lend reached near-parity in a year — the range caps hot-regime share at 4.5%.
v2.captureNote: No fee share, no standing buyback (DAO discretion only) — heavy discount in cold regimes.

cycleAnchor.note: APPROXIMATE — aggregators computed no KMNO mcap in Dec 2024 (self-reported supply), but CoinGecko (Sep 2024) and CMC (Dec 2024) independently show 1.35B circulating; the $0.237 close on Dec 15, 2024 implies ~$320M (~$335M intraday). Max aggregator-verified mcap: $264M (Sep 2025, 2.81B circ).

tokens.caveats: ATH market cap is a computed estimate (~$330–430M). Lending share is falling quarter-over-quarter — re-check before major updates.

tokens.name: Backpack
tokens.revenueNote: No audited revenue disclosure yet. Backpack reports $400B+ cumulative and ~$500M+/day trading volume (early 2026); fee revenue is not published, so the plausibility layer stays n/a until it is.
tokens.unlockNote: TGE Mar 23, 2026: 25% (250M) airdropped to points holders and Mad Lads — zero to founders, employees or investors. Pre-IPO tranche (37.5%) unlocks on company milestones (regulatory approvals, product launches, market access) and goes to users; Post-IPO treasury (37.5%) stays locked until ≥1 year after a potential IPO. The schedule modeled here assumes staged milestone releases reaching ~500M by end-2029 — an assumption, not a published timetable.
tokens.valueCapture: Staking-gated fee tiers (to 0% maker / 0.018% taker), priority IPO access, and a unique stake-to-equity conversion: up to 20% of Backpack company shares allocated to ≥1-year stakers. No disclosed fee share or buyback — capture is an equity-option claim, not cash flow.
tokens.marketShareNote: Regulated Solana-native exchange (MiCA licence via the FTX EU acquisition) with an integrated wallet: $400B+ cumulative volume, ~$500M+/day. First-mover on tokenized equities via Backpack Securities (SPCX, NVDA, AAPL, MU and more onchain).

comparables.name: HYPE's Nov 2025 peak — the perp-venue token leader
BNB's Oct 2025 peak — the exchange-network ceiling
BP's own Jun 2026 peak market cap

v2.shareNote: The ~1.4% floor prices today's regulated venue (~3-5% of the leader's volume, token launched into the trough); the 3% ceiling prices the tokenized-equities expansion — a flatter range than peers because the regulated-exchange business is steadier than pure perp flow.
v2.captureNote: No disclosed fee share or buyback — discounted in cold regimes, but less than pure governance tokens: the stake-to-equity claim (20% of company shares) and fee-tier utility are live mechanisms, and hot regimes price the IPO path.

cycleAnchor.note: No cycle history (Mar 2026 TGE). The $0.785 price ATH (Jun 21, 2026) was worth ~$196M on the fixed 250M float — three months of trading, all inside a trough. Anchor referenced to ~4-5% of HYPE's verified $19.13B peak (Backpack's approximate share of perp-venue volume applied to the sector leader's realized peak). Approximate by construction.

tokens.caveats: Young token (Mar 2026 TGE) — market figures as of 2026-07-24, added between snapshot refreshes. Milestone-based unlocks make the supply schedule an explicit assumption. Several third-party articles claim a 40%-of-fees buyback-and-burn; Backpack's own documentation does not state one, so it is NOT assumed here — re-verify at the next refresh.

tokens.name: Bitcoin
tokens.revenueNote: No protocol revenue — BTC is modeled purely as monetary share of total crypto (dominance). Miner fees exist but accrue to miners, not holders.
tokens.unlockNote: Nearly fixed: ~95.5% of the 21M cap is mined. Issuance ~0.82%/yr until the ~April 2028 halving, then ~0.40%/yr. Price scenarios are demand-driven.
tokens.valueCapture: The monetary base asset of crypto: scarcity, ETF flows, halving cycle.
tokens.marketShareNote: BTC dominance ~56.5% today (a high-dominance bear regime); 58.5% at the Oct 2025 peak; 38-41% at alt-heavy extremes (late 2021, 2022). Annual averages rose 45.6% (2023) → 59.3% (2025).

comparables.name: BTC's own Oct 2025 all-time-high market cap
Gold's market cap (the long-term bull benchmark)

monetary.note: BTC dominance FALLS as cycle strength rises (alt seasons dilute it): ~62% in a deep bear, ~49% in a normal cycle, ~38% in a full alt-season euphoria — the 2021-2022 extremes were 38-41%, and 2019-2021 peaked near 70%.

cycleAnchor.note: VERIFIED max realized mcap: $2.513T on Oct 6, 2025 ($126,198 × 19.93M BTC) — the top of the last cycle. BTC has since drawn down ~49%.

tokens.caveats: ETF flows are volatile (2026 net outflows ~120k BTC vs >500k inflows in 2024) but only ~12% of cumulative inflows have been redeemed.

tokens.name: Ethereum
tokens.revenueNote: Modeled as monetary share of total crypto: ETH is the settlement and collateral asset of the largest smart-contract ecosystem. Fee burn exists but net issuance is currently mildly positive (~+0.23%/yr post-Dencun).
tokens.unlockNote: Effectively flat supply: ~+0.25%/yr net (staking issuance ~1,700 ETH/day vs ~50-70 burned post-Dencun). ~30% of supply is soft-locked in staking.
tokens.valueCapture: Monetary/collateral premium + staking yield (3.5-4.5%); deflation returns only if mainnet activity pushes gas above ~16 gwei.
tokens.marketShareNote: ETH's share of total crypto: ~9.9% today (near its 6.95% all-time low of Apr 2025); 13-15% around its Aug 2025 price peak; 20-22% at the 2021-cycle top. Hot regimes assume an ETH season recovering toward — but staying below — the 2021 band.

comparables.name: ETH's Aug 2025 all-time-high market cap
ETH's Nov 2021 cycle-peak market cap

monetary.note: ETH's share of total crypto: ~9.9% today (near its 6.95% all-time low of Apr 2025); 13-15% around its Aug 2025 price peak; 20-22% at the 2021-cycle top. Hot regimes assume an ETH season recovering toward — but staying below — the 2021 band.

cycleAnchor.note: VERIFIED max realized mcap: $597B on Aug 24, 2025 ($4,946 × 120.7M) — slightly ABOVE the Nov 2021 peak (~$578B). ETH's share peaked in Aug-Sep 2025 (13-15%), before the market's Oct top.

tokens.caveats: Share history is regime-dependent: ETH held 15-19% through the 2022 bear but sits near all-time-low share in 2026 — structural competition from SOL and L2 fee migration are real headwinds.

tokens.name: BNB
tokens.revenueNote: Modeled as monetary share of total crypto: BNB's demand is exchange-linked (Binance fee discounts, Launchpad, BNB Chain gas) with a mechanical burn floor rather than protocol revenue to holders.
tokens.unlockNote: Supply SHRINKS ~4.8%/yr: quarterly Auto-Burn (~1.6M BNB, formula-based and larger when price is LOWER) plus real-time BEP-95 gas burns, toward a 100M long-run target (~2031-2033).
tokens.valueCapture: Quarterly auto-burn + BEP-95 gas burn (deflation accelerates in bears); exchange utility demand.
tokens.marketShareNote: ~3.3% of total crypto today (#4 asset). Defensive share: it peaked at ~5.4% at the Nov 2022 trough because BNB drew down less than the market; ~4.3% at the Oct 2025 peak.

comparables.name: BNB's own Oct 2025 peak market cap
BNB's Nov 2022 bear-trough share of total (5.4%)

monetary.note: BNB's share is mildly counter-cyclical: higher in bears (defensive, ~5.4% at the 2022 trough), diluted toward ~3% in alt-heavy euphoria — while the shrinking supply converts mcap into price faster than for any other large cap.

cycleAnchor.note: APPROXIMATE — supply-consistent computation ($1,370 × ~138.8M = ~$190B, Oct 13 2025); one source cites $158B, inconsistent with the supply. BNB briefly flipped XRP and USDT by mcap that week.

tokens.caveats: Burn pace is price-dependent (lower price → bigger burns); end-2029 supply ~110-115M. Peak mcap flagged approximate.

tokens.name: Hyperliquid
tokens.revenueNote: The largest revenue machine in DeFi: ~$685M annualized protocol revenue (30d run-rate; trailing 12m ~$950M), with 97-99% of ALL fees flowing to the Assistance Fund's automated HYPE buybacks (~$2M/day — buyback intensity ~7% of mcap annualized, 4-5x ETH/BNB).
tokens.unlockNote: Heavy vesting through late 2027: core contributors unlock ~9.9M HYPE/month (1-yr cliff passed Nov 2025, 24-month linear), partly offset by ~1M/month buybacks — circulating grows ~222M → ~350M by mid-2027, peaks ~372M, then turns NET DEFLATIONARY (buyback-only regime).
tokens.valueCapture: 97-99% of perp+spot fees → Assistance Fund buybacks; priority fees burned (total supply already 955M from 1B). The strongest value capture of any major token.
tokens.marketShareNote: ~85% of the perp-DEX token sector; reclaimed ~37% of perp-DEX volume in Q2 2026; ~13% of ALL crypto perp volume incl. CEXes. The upside thesis is exchange-network convergence: Hyperliquid as the on-chain Binance analogue (HyperEVM L1 + spot + perps), benchmarked against BNB rather than DeFi apps.

comparables.name: BNB's Oct 2025 peak — the exchange-network precedent
HYPE's own Nov 2025 peak market cap

v2.shareNote: HYPE is ~85% of the perp-DEX token pool and ~70% of on-chain perp open interest. Cold stops treat it as a perps app; hot stops price the exchange-network thesis — Hyperliquid as a broader exchange + L1 financial network (the sector allocation expands accordingly, BNB-calibrated).
v2.captureNote: Near-perfect capture (97-99% of fees to buybacks) — almost no discount in any regime.
v2.ceilingNote: The ceiling is the exchange-network precedent, not the DeFi-app one: BNB — the realized exchange-network benchmark — holds ~3.3% of total crypto today and peaked at ~5.4% in the 2022 bear. HYPE beyond ~3.3% of ALL crypto would mean out-scaling BNB's entire realized history.

cycleAnchor.note: VERIFIED max realized mcap: $19.13B on Nov 27, 2025 ($57.38 × ~333M circulating). The price ATH is disputed (CMC $76.67 vs CoinGecko $61.11, Jun 2026) but the mcap max predates both — tracked float SHRANK as Assistance Fund holdings (44.4M HYPE) were excluded. Another case where mcap, not price, is the honest anchor.

tokens.caveats: Tracker supply methodologies differ (CoinGecko/CMC ~222M float vs CryptoRank 455M 'unlocked' incl. AF holdings). Revenue is volume-dependent and was ~2x higher at the Nov 2025 peak.

tokens.name: Zcash
tokens.revenueNote: No cash flow to holders (PoW chain; 20% of block rewards fund development). ZEC is modeled purely as a monetary/privacy premium — a share of total crypto.
tokens.unlockNote: Bitcoin-like emission: ~657K ZEC/yr until the ~Nov 2028 halving, then ~328K/yr — supply grows ~4%/yr now, ~89% of the 21M cap emitted by end-2029. 30%+ of supply sits in shielded pools.
tokens.valueCapture: Monetary premium only: privacy as the product, halving-driven scarcity, shielded adoption.
tokens.marketShareNote: ~0.41% of total crypto today (rank #11-14) — HIGHER than at its own $11B Nov 2025 peak (~0.33%), because ZEC fell less than the market: it has traded as crypto's privacy safe-haven through the 2026 drawdown.

comparables.name: ZEC's own Nov 2025 peak market cap
ZEC's 2021-cycle peak market cap (~0.15% of total)

monetary.note: ZEC holds ~0.41% of total crypto today (up from 0.15% in 2021 — the privacy re-rating of late 2025: shielded adoption, ETF filing, regulatory tailwind). Hot regimes assume the premium extends modestly; the ceiling (1%) reflects the 2017-18 privacy sector (XMR+ZEC+DASH ~2-3% of total) never being reclaimed by a single asset.

cycleAnchor.note: VERIFIED: ~$11B on Nov 7, 2025 ($744 intraday ATH × 16.35M; The Block reported the $10B+ top-20 re-entry). The +700% Sep-Nov 2025 run was driven by the privacy narrative, shielded-pool adoption (30%+ of supply), a Grayscale ETF filing and treasury buyers.

tokens.caveats: The 2016 price 'ATH' ($3,192) was a launch-float artifact — ignore it. The privacy premium is narrative-driven and could unwind as fast as it appeared; Downside models exactly that.

tokens.name: NEAR Protocol
tokens.revenueNote: Modeled as monetary share of total crypto (L1 asset). Tx fees are burned and the Feb 2026 Intents fee-switch buys NEAR on the open market, but inflation still exceeds burns today.
tokens.unlockNote: The 2026 tokenomics overhaul HALVED max inflation to 2.5%/yr; net issuance ~2.3%/yr after burns/buybacks → ~1.41B by end-2029 (vs ~1.53B under the old regime). No max supply.
tokens.valueCapture: Fee burn + Intents fee-to-buyback (Feb 2026, deflationary above ~$177M daily Intents volume); staking; inflation still net positive.
tokens.marketShareNote: ~0.11% of total crypto (rank #34; top ~12-15 smart-contract L1). Repositioned as 'the blockchain for AI' (Intents crossed $6B cumulative volume, chain-abstraction super-app) — relevant again, but -90.6% from ATH.

comparables.name: NEAR's own Jan 2022 peak market cap (~0.6% of total)
